fullPassage: The use of emotion may be important in exercise, particularly among exercise instructors. It has been established that exercise enjoyment is associated with increased exercise adherence. An instructor might aim to foster enjoyment in his participants as a means of increasing their program adherence. An instructor also might use emotion to elicit greater effort from her students. Cuing participants to feelings of anger and frustration during a cardio kickboxing class might lead to more effortful punches and stronger kicks. Like this, sports instructors may want to consider monitoring the physical conditions under which students exercise to help prevent injury. Conversely, a yoga instructor could use positive emotions or emotion-related states such as compassion to get her students in the proper mindset for their practice. Evidently, there are a number of ways emotions could be used to enhance performance in sport and exercise.

questions.passage: The use of emotion may be important in exercise, particularly among exercise instructors. It has been established that exercise enjoyment is associated with increased exercise adherence. An instructor might aim to ①<u>foster</u> enjoyment in his participants as a means of increasing their program adherence. An instructor also might use emotion to ②<u>elicit</u> greater effort from her students. Cuing participants to feelings of anger and frustration during a cardio kickboxing class might lead to more effortful punches and stronger kicks. Like this, sports instructors may want to consider monitoring the physical conditions under which students exercise to help prevent injury. Conversely, a yoga instructor could use positive emotions or emotion-related states such as compassion to get her students in the ③<u>wrong</u> mindset for their practice. Evidently, there are a number of ways emotions could be used to ④<u>enhance</u> performance in sport and exercise.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①foster(촉진), ②elicit(이끌어내다), ④enhance(향상시키다)는 원문과 일치합니다. ③wrong(잘못된)은 원문의 proper(적절한)를 반의어로 교체한 것입니다.
det.analysis:
❌ ①②④: 원문 그대로
✅ ③ wrong → proper: 요가 강사는 적절한(proper) 마음가짐을 갖게 하는 것이 목적
det.tip: proper(적절한) ↔ wrong(잘못된): 문맥상 적절하지 않은 어휘
